SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH input AS (SELECT NULLIF($1, '')::uuid AS requested_run_id, $2::text AS run_key), existing AS (SELECT r.id FROM cris_test_runs r, input i WHERE r.id = i.requested_run_id), inserted AS (INSERT INTO cris_test_runs (run_key, delivery_mode, allow_public_messages, requested_windows, scenario_groups, input, created_by) SELECT input.run_key, 'shadow', false, ARRAY['3m']::text[], ARRAY['shadow']::text[], jsonb_build_object('source', 'cris-qa-shadow-master'), 'n8n-cris-qa-shadow' FROM input WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing) ON CONFLICT (run_key) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = now() RETURNING id) SELECT coalesce((SELECT id FROM existing), (SELECT id FROM inserted)) AS run_id;

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
INSERT INTO cris_test_outbox (run_id, case_id, delivery_mode, channel, target_phone, target_conversation_id, message_type, would_send_payload, sent, external_status, external_response) VALUES ($1::uuid, NULLIF($2, '')::uuid, 'shadow', 'whatsapp', NULLIF($3, ''), NULLIF($4, '')::uuid, $5, $6::jsonb, false, 'shadow_recorded', jsonb_build_object('source', 'cris-qa-shadow-master')) RETURNING id AS outbox_id, run_id, case_id, target_phone, message_type, sent, created_at;
